text: so uh we the other day added the vehicle lab and were messing with the handling. the claude who did it tho, put in a thing where when the car rolls over it just stops the whole thing / resets the car. but thats wrong, we want it to just keep playing out. also, the sensitivity on it is insane i cant even make a turn and it jsut says i rolled over and i didnt xD
resolution: Same task as req_0709 (your first phrasing of it). Fixed in commit 4a6c7351f: the vehicle-lab rollover now plays out and self-rights instead of freezing the car into a 'FLIPPED — press R' lock or resetting it. The over-sensitive flicker came from a trip kick too weak to clear the ±π/2 peak (half-lean-and-snap-back); the kick now commits the roll, light airborne damping carries it over, and it auto-rights on rest. See req_0709 for the full writeup.
